product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Kristin Mid-Century Wood-Framed Sleeper Armchair, 55.5"W, Azure
product.description: This chair’s foam-padded cushions sit loosely on the hardwood frame, making them easy to remove and creating a casual look that gives any space a welcoming and comfortable appearance. Performance fabrics and reversible seat cushions make this chair easy to maintain. 55.5"W x 37"D x 37.5"H Performance fabric over padded solid-wood frame with mortise-and-tenon construction; poly-Dacron foam filling Loose back and seat cushions are removable and reversible, ensuring durability and comfort. Chair easily opens to provide extra sleeping space. Sewn-in detailing along front provides texture. No assembly required Quickly blot spills with a damp cloth. Use a soft, dry cloth for routine care. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
